product.title: Blue Daisy Family Matching Set - Dress, Shirt & Romper
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Lightweight summer woven fabric; exact fiber composition was not visible in the supplied evidence.
  • Family story: A polished warm-weather matching look for mom, dad, girls, boys, and baby.
  • Print reference: Blue Daisy pairs bright blue flowers, yellow centers, and green leaves for an easy vacation-photo palette.
  • Design details: Girls and moms wear the sleeveless floral dress, boys and dads wear the collared short-sleeve shirt, and baby sizes use the matching romper chart.
  • Care: Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach, and cool iron inside-out if needed.
  • Size range: Baby 0-3M-12-18M, Child 1-2Y-10Y, Mother S-2XL, and Father S-4XL.

Blue Daisy makes family matching feel fresh and vacation-ready, with a bright floral print that ties each role together without making every piece identical. The dresses bring a floaty, sunny shape for moms and girls, while the collared shirts keep dads and boys coordinated in a relaxed way.

The attached chart also supports baby romper sizes, so this draft keeps that piece as its own Type instead of hiding it inside the dress or shirt ladder. White shorts, shoes, hats, bags, and other styling pieces shown in the photo are not included.

Key Features:

  • Three honest Types: Baby Romper, Dress, and Shirt are separated for clearer size selection.
  • Family-ready size run: Baby, child, mother, and father rows follow the attached vendor chart.
  • Blue floral palette: Blue blossoms and yellow centers create a bright warm-weather matching story.
  • Photo-ready styling: Dresses and shirts coordinate neatly for trips, portraits, brunches, and summer plans.
  • Chart-first variants: Every purchasable option is backed by a transcribed source row.

Choose the Type and size for each family member to build the matching Blue Daisy look for your next sunny plan.
